description: Build the damage_frontend Vite+React+TypeScript project at /home/ma7moud-5aled/Projects/Accident_Intel/damage_frontend/. This is completely separate from the existing frontend/ directory. It is a 4-section damage inspection dashboard: Upload → Photos → Review → Cost. Depends on FEAT-001 being complete so TypeScript types can be written to match backend response shapes.
steps: Scaffold the Vite project: run 'npm create vite@latest damage_frontend -- --template react-ts' from /home/ma7moud-5aled/Projects/Accident_Intel/. Then cd into damage_frontend and run 'npm install' to install base deps.

Install additional dependencies inside damage_frontend/: 'npm install tailwindcss@3 postcss autoprefixer lucide-react axios'. Then initialize Tailwind: 'npx tailwindcss init -p'. This creates tailwind.config.js and postcss.config.js.

Configure Tailwind: update tailwind.config.js content array to ['./index.html', './src/**/*.{ts,tsx}']. Update src/index.css to contain the three Tailwind directives (@tailwind base; @tailwind components; @tailwind utilities;) and remove default Vite CSS. Remove src/App.css if it exists.

Configure vite.config.ts in damage_frontend/ to: set server.port = 5174, server.host = '0.0.0.0', server.allowedHosts = 'all', server.strictPort = false; set server.proxy: { '/api': { target: 'http://localhost:8001', changeOrigin: true } }. Keep @vitejs/plugin-react plugin.

Create damage_frontend/src/services/api.ts. Use axios.create({ baseURL: import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL ?? '', timeout: 120000 }) — long timeout because YOLO inference takes time. Export: analyzePhotos(formData: FormData): Promise<AnalyzeResponse> using axios post with multipart; getConfig(): Promise<ConfigResponse>; estimateCost(body: { analysis_id: string; rows: AnalysisRow[]; make: string; model_name: string; year: number; tier: string; use_web: boolean }): Promise<CostResponse>. Import types from '../types'. Normalize axios errors to Error with detail message.

Create damage_frontend/src/hooks/useAppState.ts. Manage top-level application state with useState/useCallback. State shape: { step: 'upload' | 'photos' | 'review' | 'cost'; analysisResult: AnalyzeResponse | null; editedRows: AnalysisRow[]; costResult: CostResponse | null; costStale: boolean; loading: boolean; error: string | null; config: ConfigResponse | null }. Expose: goToStep(s), setAnalysisResult (also resets editedRows to result.rows, resets costResult/costStale), setEditedRows (also sets costStale=true if costResult exists), setCostResult, setLoading, setError, loadConfig. The hook calls getConfig() on mount.

Create damage_frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx. Renders a horizontal tab bar. Props: step, canViewResults (boolean, true after analysis). Tabs: [{id:'upload', label:'1. Upload'}, {id:'photos', label:'2. Photos'}, {id:'review', label:'3. Review'}, {id:'cost', label:'4. Cost'}]. Tabs 2-4 disabled (not clickable) when canViewResults=false. Active tab: blue underline, dark navy text (#1e293b). Inactive enabled: gray text. Disabled: lighter gray, cursor-not-allowed. No icons needed — clean text tabs.

Create damage_frontend/src/components/UploadSection.tsx. Props: onAnalyze(formData: FormData) => void; loading: boolean; error: string | null. Internal state: make (string), modelName (string), year (number, default 2020), tier ('economy'|'mid'|'luxury', default 'mid'), useVlm (boolean, default true), useWeb (boolean, default false), files (File[]). Render: two-column layout on desktop (form fields left, dropzone right). Form fields: Make text input, Model text input, Year number input (min 1980 max 2026), Tier select (Economy/Mid/Luxury). Checkboxes: Use VLM (checked), Look up prices online (unchecked). Dropzone: a div with onDragOver/onDrop handlers (preventDefault on dragover, read dataTransfer.files on drop), onClick opens hidden . Show thumbnails grid: each thumbnail is an with object-cover, 80x80px, with an X button (remove that file). Analyze button: disabled when files.length===0 or !make.trim() || !modelName.trim() or loading. On click: build FormData appending each file under key 'files', and form fields (make, model_name, year, tier, use_vlm, use_web) then call onAnalyze(formData). Show spinner + 'Detecting damage and car parts...' text when loading. Show error in red box if error exists.

Create damage_frontend/src/components/PhotoSection.tsx. Props: photos: PhotoResult[]; warnings: string[]. For each photo render a card. Card header: photo_id. If !usable: orange warning card with notes. If usable: two-column layout. Left: image viewer with tab buttons (Original | Combined | Parts | Damage). Active tab shows corresponding URL from image_urls (original, combined, parts, damage). Use tag with src set to the active URL — since Vite proxies /api to backend, the URLs like /api/images/... work directly. Right: detection list — if items.length===0: 'No damage detected'. Else: list of items, each showing damage_type badge, part, severity badge (color-coded: minor=green, moderate=yellow, severe=red), confidence percentage, part_source chip. If needs_review on photo items: show '?' chip. Show overall warnings as yellow banners at top of section.

Create damage_frontend/src/components/ReviewSection.tsx. Props: rows: AnalysisRow[]; config: ConfigResponse | null; onRowsChange: (rows: AnalysisRow[]) => void. Render a table with columns: Part (select from config.part_choices), Damage Type (select from config.damage_types), Severity (select from config.severities), Count (number input min 1), Confidence (read-only — show value to 2 decimals or 'manual' if null), Flagged (read-only checkbox, reflects needs_review), Reviewed (editable checkbox). Per-row delete button (trash icon). At bottom: '+ Add Row' button that appends a new row with defaults {part: config.part_choices[0], damage_type: config.damage_types[0], severity: 'moderate', count: 1, confidence: null, needs_review: false, reviewed: true}. IMPORTANT: flagged rows (needs_review=true) must NOT be auto-checked as reviewed — the user must manually tick them. Editable fields call onRowsChange with updated rows array on every change. Rows with needs_review=true: show entire row with a subtle yellow background.

Create damage_frontend/src/components/CostSection.tsx. Props: rows: AnalysisRow[]; analysisId: string | null; make: string; modelName: string; year: number; tier: string; costResult: CostResponse | null; costStale: boolean; loading: boolean; error: string | null; onCalculate: () => void. Render: yellow banner when costStale: 'Damages changed since last estimate — recalculate'. Calculate Cost button (blue, primary). When loading: spinner. If error: red box. If costResult: three summary cards (Total EGP range, Unconfirmed EGP range, Parts count). Below cards: itemized table with columns: Part | Work | Damages | New Part | Labor | Paint | Total (EGP) | Price Source | Unconfirmed. Format ranges with fmtRange(lo, hi) = lo===0 && hi===0 ? '-' : lo.toLocaleString() + ' – ' + hi.toLocaleString(). Rows where needs_review=true: italic + yellow badge. Below table: notes (gray text), unpriced warnings (orange), cost warnings. Download JSON button: triggers download of JSON.stringify(costResult.cost, null, 2) as 'cost.json'.

Create damage_frontend/src/App.tsx. Import useAppState, Navigation, UploadSection, PhotoSection, ReviewSection, CostSection. On mount: load config via hook. Step routing: render the active section based on step state. Wire onAnalyze: build formData from UploadSection, call api.analyzePhotos, call setAnalysisResult, advance step to 'photos', catch errors -> setError. Wire onCalculate in CostSection: call api.estimateCost with current editedRows + car info from state, call setCostResult, catch errors. Pass car info (make, model, year, tier) from state — store it when user submits the analyze form. Keep a carInfo state { make, model, year, tier } updated when the analyze form submits. Navigation onStepChange: just call goToStep if canViewResults. Layout: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 py-6. Navigation at top. Section content below. Design tokens via Tailwind: bg-white, text-slate-800, accent blue-600, card shadow-sm border border-slate-200 rounded-lg p-6.

Create damage_frontend/README.md with: project description, prerequisites (Node 18+, Python 3.13, pip install -r requirements.txt from repo root), backend startup instructions (cd /home/ma7moud-5aled/Projects/Accident_Intel && PYTHONPATH=src/Car_damage_cost uvicorn damage_backend.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8001 --reload), frontend startup (cd damage_frontend && cp .env.example .env && npm install && npm run dev), required env vars (DAMAGE_WEIGHTS, PARTS_WEIGHTS, VLM_BASE_URL, VLM_MODEL, VLM_API, VLM_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY for web pricing), Lightning AI notes (set VITE_API_BASE_URL to the Lightning AI proxy URL for port 8001, keep allowedHosts: 'all' in vite.config.ts), build for production (npm run build -> dist/ served by any static host).
acceptance_criteria: cd /home/ma7moud-5aled/Projects/Accident_Intel/damage_frontend && npm run build completes with zero TypeScript errors and zero Vite build errors
All four sections (UploadSection, PhotoSection, ReviewSection, CostSection) render without runtime errors in the built app
Edited rows in ReviewSection are preserved when navigating between Photos/Review/Cost tabs
CostSection shows stale banner when rows change after a cost result exists
Download JSON button in CostSection works
No files under src/Car_damage_cost/, src/api/, or frontend/ are modified
findings: damage_frontend scaffolded with Vite 8 + React 19 + TypeScript. All 15 steps implemented in order. Deviations from spec: (1) allowedHosts set to boolean true instead of string 'all' — Vite 8 type is string[] | true, not string; behavior is identical (allow all hosts). All other spec details preserved exactly. Build output: dist/index.html + CSS 14.6KB gzip 3.6KB + JS 299.9KB gzip 94.6KB. Zero TypeScript errors. Components: Navigation, UploadSection, PhotoSection, ReviewSection, CostSection. Hook: useAppState (setEditedRows sets costStale=true when costResult exists; flagged rows not auto-reviewed). API service: axios timeout 120000ms, baseURL from VITE_API_BASE_URL. Vite proxy: /api -> http://localhost:8001. Image tabs use where url = /api/images/... (proxied). Tailwind 3 configured. README includes all required docs.
